Boot through the shared helper and override only the one token this flow needs.

/**
 * The spec-facing surface of the test infrastructure: specs import everything they need from
 * `../../infra` and never reach into the module tree directly.
 */
export { TestingInfraModule } from "./testing-infra.module"
export { TestContext, TESTING_INFRA_OPTIONS } from "./testing-infra.options"
export type { TestingInfraOptions } from "./testing-infra.options"

export { BACKEND_ROOT, COMPOSE_FILE, E2EStackService } from "./platform/stack/e2e-stack.service"
export type {
    E2ECleanupReport,
    E2ECleanupStep,
    E2EComposeIdentity,
    E2EServiceEndpoint,
    E2EServiceName,
} from "./platform/stack/e2e-stack.service"

export { E2EDbService } from "./platform/databases/e2e-db.service"

export { E2EHttpService } from "./integrations/http/e2e-http.service"
export type { E2EHttpClient, E2EHttpClientOptions, E2EResponse } from "./integrations/http/e2e-http.service"

export { E2EAuthService } from "./bussiness/accounts/e2e-auth.service"
